# hllset-cortex — Handoff

> **Date:** August 2026
> **Repo:** DeepSeek-OCR/hllset_cortex (branch `feature/hllset-cortex-git`)
> **Vision:** the previous projects (EWM-nanoLM, caal-llm) were built for a
> narrower scope and their docs reflect it. This project is the implementation
> of a **much wider vision** — EWM as the grounding/search engine for an LLM.
> New features found here are a reflection of that wider vision and **live
> here** (hllset-cortex), not pushed back upstream.

8. `8741cd2` token vs structural hallucination (LUT diagnoses, never hallucinates)

10. `8ec8625` precedent retrieval from the temporal-pyramid history

(+ `domain.py`: `tid` / `hllset_from_ids`).

## Principles crystallized this phase

- **Two spaces, two morphisms.** Tokens (encodings) and HLLSets never cross
  directly; only `ingest` (tokens → HLLSet, hash + bootstrap) and
  `materialize` (HLLSet → tokens). Structural ops (BSS, R-link, DRN, pyramid)
  are HLLSet-space; LLM interchange + TokenLUT are token-space.
- **Two hallucination diagnoses.** Token hallucination (LUT flags unknown
  encodings) vs structural hallucination (BSS ρ flags departure). The LUT
  never hallucinates; the HLLSet the LLM produces does.
- **Exact-LUT gate** (0 leak / 0 FN) ⇒ the ds-ocr encoder is bypassable.
- **One operation, three views.** search / shallow grounding / deep grounding
  (precedents) are the same R-link/BSS comparison over different reference sets.
- **BSS ρ needs same-scale cardinalities** (cardinality = the '1'-bit
  distribution in the fixed 32,768-bit vector).

   precedents. Reflect them in the protocol/standard.
